scope: Controlled native observation; not subtree-cache qualification or a performance benchmark

primarySources.supports: FSEvents history is advisory; notification latency is nondeterministic; start monitoring before initial observation.
FlushAsync flushes events buffered by the configured latency and returns the largest queued event ID; it does not establish recursive metadata coverage.
ATTR_CMNEXT_RECURSIVE_GENCOUNT is a uint64 for APFS maintain-dir-stats directories; unmarked directories return zero. Per-file ATTR_CMN_GEN_COUNT is invalid while mmap is active.
Recursive generation count request maps to va_recursive_gencount and packs a uint64 only when supported.

probe.readOnlyQuery: open directory with O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC | O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW; fgetattrlist with commonattr ATTR_CMN_RETURNED_ATTRS and forkattr ATTR_CMNEXT_RECURSIVE_GENCOUNT, FSOPT_ATTR_CMN_EXTENDED; validate returned forkattr bit and decode uint64 at four-byte aligned offset 24; separately fstatfs to identify filesystem.
probe.fixture: New private temporary directory, initially empty; own nested directory and regular file only; no user root or application cache changed.

reproduction.existingRootCommand: /private/tmp/sweepx-rgencount <selected existing directory roots>; read-only query only
reproduction.controlledFixtureCommand: python3 fixture.py; run with host service access to compare sandbox mark refusal
reproduction.fixtureDriver:
import tempfile, os, subprocess, mmap, json, pathlib, time
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='sweepx-gencount-', dir='/private/tmp'))
report={'root':str(root), 'setup':[], 'observations': []}
mark = subprocess.run(['/System/Library/Filesystems/apfs.fs/Contents/Resources/apfs.util','-M',str(root)],capture_output=True,text=True)
report['setup'].append({'markRc':mark.returncode,'out':mark.stdout,'err':mark.stderr})
child = root / 'nested'
child.mkdir()
file = child / 'data'
def obs(label):
 report['observations'].append({'label':label,'out':subprocess.check_output(['/private/tmp/sweepx-rgencount',str(root),str(child)],text=True)})
obs('root marked, nested created')
file.write_bytes(b'abc'); obs('file created')
file.write_bytes(b'abd'); obs('same length write')
with file.open('ab') as f: f.write(b'efg')
obs('extension')
os.truncate(file,2); obs('truncate')
os.chmod(file,0o400); obs('file chmod')
os.chmod(file,0o600)
subprocess.check_call(['xattr','-w','user.fixture','val',str(file)]); obs('file xattr')
file.rename(child / 'renamed'); file=child / 'renamed'; obs('rename')
with file.open('r+b') as f:
 m=mmap.mmap(f.fileno(),0,access=mmap.ACCESS_WRITE); obs('mmap opened'); m[0]=ord('x'); obs('mmap written before flush'); m.flush(); obs('mmap flushed'); m.close(); obs('mmap closed')
link = root / 'other-link'; os.link(file,link); obs('hardlink within tree')
outside=root.parent / (root.name+'-outside-link'); os.link(file,outside); obs('hardlink outside tree')
with outside.open('ab') as f: f.write(b'a')
obs('outside hardlink length write')
file.unlink(); obs('child unlink')
os.unlink(outside)
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

limitations: One controlled marked-directory fixture and one read-only query per existing root category; no broad target-platform or filesystem qualification.
APFS marked-dir count changed on ordinary descendant data/namespace mutations but did not immediately change for chmod/xattr or dirty mmap before flush.
Only the explicitly marked fixture root supplied a nonzero recursive count; its nested directory stayed zero.
No native mount, provider, offline or cross-volume mutation fixture was run.
Observed increments are not an expected arithmetic contract; equality cannot be assumed to cover untested fields.
Production changes do not set maintain-dir-stats on user directories or authorize subtree skipping.
No latency, throughput, p95/p99 or performance conclusion is derived from these probes.
conclusion: Neither empty FSEvents history nor the probed recursive APFS generation count qualifies whole-subtree replay of current filesystem/classification facts. Default junk optimization consumes current native bulk metadata and still walks directories.
